product.name: Stage Right by Monoprice Universal 2-button Guitar Amp Footswitch
product.description: This is a replacement 2-button footswitch for the 611830 Guitar Short Stack bundle. It controls the reverb and channel selection between the clean and overdrive channels. Its cable is 20 feet (6 meters) long and features a metal housing with a black finish.
